{{Quote|At least I can use this asteroid field to sharpen my ''piloting skills''.|[[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]|<ref name="Milk Run to Maarka!" />}}
An '''asteroid field''' was located near [[Maarka]], in the [[Perkell sector/Legends|Perkell sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. While on a mission to deliver a [[Datafile/Legends|data file]] with important intelligence for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Maarka Republic base|base]] on Maarka, [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] was [[Skirmish in unidentified asteroid field (Maarka)|ambushed]] by six [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid starfighters]] in this [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid field]].
